verdicts.reason: A is the original layout spread out vertically: the logo, headline, body, badges and CTA are separated by huge, uneven gaps, so the group falls apart, and the CTA sits stranded near the bottom with dead space around everything. B groups the copy, badges and CTA into one readable block with strong headline and CTA hierarchy. Its alignment is arbitrary, though: the GLACIER logo, headline, badges and CTA each start at a different left edge. The product circle is pushed into the top-left, leaving the top-right empty, so B is lopsided and still needs fixes.
